description: Query ranked leaderboard entries by timeframe, scope, component column, and legal chart/build version.

main.description: Returns ranked entries for a `games.opengaming.leaderboard.definition`, filtered by timeframe, `rankedVersions`, cryptographic verification (or post-EoS open mode), publisher `games.opengaming.revocation` records, ATProto moderation labels, and social graph.

timeframe.description: Time window derived from `recordedAt` (must be one of the definition's `timeframes`).

scope.description: `public` returns global scores; `social` filters to `viewer` and accounts `viewer` follows (`app.bsky.graph.follow`).

viewer.description: Optional viewer DID used to compute `social` scope and return `viewerEntry`.

sortBy.description: Optional component key from `leaderboard.definition#components` to sort rankings by (defaults to `defaultComponent` or headline `score`).

version.description: Optional chart/build version hash filter. When omitted and `leaderboard.definition#rankedVersions` is non-empty, only scores matching `rankedVersions` are returned.

verifiedOnly.description: When true, excludes unverified scores, publisher-revoked (`games.opengaming.revocation`) records, and records carrying invalidating ATProto moderation labels.

sortedBy.description: Component key used to rank entries when the leaderboard defines `components`.

viewerEntry.description: The `viewer`'s own best non-revoked entry in the requested timeframe, if any.

attestationCid.description: Computed repository-bound attestation CIDv1 of the score record.

issuer.description: DID of the publisher, host, or revival server whose attestation verified this entry.

labels.description: Active ATProto moderation or replay-verification label values attached to this record.

verified.description: True if verified by a trusted `#attestations` DID key (or community `verified-replay` label) AND neither publisher-revoked nor invalidated by moderation labels.

revoked.description: True if invalidated by a publisher `games.opengaming.revocation` record or trusted anti-cheat moderation label (only returned when `verifiedOnly` is false).
